entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Support' for product help or 'Sales' for new orders.
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi... I... I need to return something. My VeloBand sensor. I have the order number if you need it.
I can certainly look into that for you. What is the order number?

Got it. One moment... Okay, I see the order for the VeloBand Cadence Sensor, delivered 38 days ago. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
Oh, um, a preference I guess? It just wasn't what I thought. I tried to return it a long, long time ago, but the whole process is just so overwhelming. I think the website was broken.
I'm sorry to hear you had trouble with the website. Can you tell me a bit more about what happened when you tried to process the return online?

Well, I went to the returns page, filled everything out, and then a big red 'website error' message popped up. I kept trying, but I couldn't get past it. I couldn't print the label. It felt like the whole system was down. I even took a screenshot because I was so confused. Can't you just help me?

Of course, I can help. Thank you for that information. Let me just check our service alerts for that period... Yes, it looks like we did have a known issue where our return portal was down. I sincerely apologize for that inconvenience.
So... what does that mean? Am I stuck with it?

Not at all. Actually, even without that system issue, you're perfectly fine. The VeloBand Cadence Sensor falls under our standard 10-day return policy. Since it was delivered 38 days ago, you are unfortunately outside the window for a full refund.
Oh! Ninety days? I thought it was much shorter. That's a huge relief. Thank you.

You are very welcome. I've just processed the return for you and sent a pre-paid shipping label to the email address on file. You can simply print that out and attach it to the box. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
No, that's perfect. Thank you so much for your help, Charlie.
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a wonderful day.
